locations.name: La Gamba (Palamós)
locations.description: The Palamós classic since 1918, on the port square facing the fishing boats — the shrine of the gamba de Palamós, landed at this exact dock. The arrival-day lunch plan for Mon Sep 7 (BCN 93 min → here, then 22 min to Mas Pastora): order the SMALL gambas a la plancha, which the note flags as tastier than the big ones. Monday lunch 1:00–3:45 PM; +34 972 31 46 33.
locations.address: Plaça de Sant Pere, 1, 17230 Palamós, Girona, Spain

references.note: Option 1 pick: the classic since 1918; small gambas a la plancha are the order; Mon 1:00–3:45; arrival-day timing means no reservation stress.

locations.name: Can Blau (Palamós)
locations.description: One street back from the Palamós port — the locals' pick for rice dishes and gambas, and the highest-rated of the port cluster. Whole fish is priced by weight: ask before they cook it. Monday lunch 1:00–4:00 PM; +34 972 31 61 13.

references.note: Locals' pick for rice and gambas, highest rated; fish by weight — ask first; Mon 1:00–4:00.

locations.name: Museu de la Pesca
locations.description: Fishing museum on the Palamós dock — the story of the port that lands the famous red prawns, a natural 20-minute stop between the port lunch and the Camí de Ronda walk to Cala S'Alguer's whitewashed fishermen's huts.

references.note: Post-lunch stroll: walk the port past the fishing boats, peek at the Museu de la Pesca, then Camí de Ronda to Cala S'Alguer (~25 min each way).
